the-irish-house-kolkata.blurb: A pub on the 5th floor of Quest Mall, Park Circus, and one of the first all-day pubs in Kolkata.

tips.expect: An upbeat, cheerfully Irish-themed pub with global pub food.
tips.good: Shepherd's pie and the creative cocktails.
tips.watch: Mall hours apply, and Puja weekends are busy.
tips.tip: Good for a group of friends on the Park Circus side.

the-lords-and-barons.blurb: A two-floor Park Street bar, open since 2018, styled like a British-era club with chandeliers and amber wood.

tips.expect: Old-world elegance with live singers, retro music and open-mic nights.
tips.good: The ambience and the Tangra-style bar food.
tips.watch: Entry and tables get tight on weekends.
tips.tip: Reserve if you are going in a group on Saptami or Ashtami.

trapeze.blurb: A stylish Park Street gastropub with eclectic furnishings and a skylight, serving noodles, pizzas and pan-Asian plates.

tips.expect: A cosy, trendy room with good music and live music on Sundays.
tips.good: The pizzas and the drinks menu.
tips.watch: Pricing is on the higher side.
tips.tip: A strong pick for Sunday night.

refinery-091.blurb: A two-level industrial-style gastropub in Sector V, known for brews infused with fruit and spices and for big brunch spreads.

tips.expect: An industrial brewpub with Indian and global food.
tips.good: The experimental brews and the brunch.
tips.watch: Sector V gets crowded on weekends.
tips.tip: A group-friendly stop after the Salt Lake pandals.

motorworks-and-brewing-company.blurb: A restaurant and brewery in Sector V serving six craft beers called 'Motor Fuels' and signature beertails.
dishes: Beer Up Table (groups of 10+, unlimited beer for two hours)

tips.expect: Beer-led evenings with samplers so you can try before you choose.
tips.good: The range of beers, from stout and lager to German and Belgian wheat.
tips.watch: Group deals need at least ten people.
tips.tip: Go with friends for the samplers.

deck-88.blurb: A rooftop at The Astor Hotel, popular for years, with live music gigs on Thursdays and sometimes Sundays.

tips.expect: An open-air rooftop with a mixed menu and live bands.
tips.good: The setting on a warm October night.
tips.watch: If rain is forecast, ask about covered seating.
tips.tip: Near the Maidan and Park Street, so easy to add.

the-grid.blurb: A microbrewery at Haute Street Corporate Park, Topsia, described as one of the best in town, with a strong kitchen team.

tips.expect: Craft beer and a serious menu.
tips.watch: Topsia is off the main pandal circuits.
tips.tip: Go as a standalone evening.

level-seven-gastropub-and-rooftop-lounge.blurb: A semi-open-air rooftop bar and lounge in Topsia with city views and a multi-cuisine menu.

tips.expect: A lively rooftop with an extensive menu.
tips.watch: It is in Topsia, which takes time to reach from the pandal circuits.
tips.tip: A late-night destination.

soul-the-sky-lounge.blurb: A bohemian rooftop on Little Russel Street, once with views of Victoria Memorial. It has since become Soul Atrium at a new address.

tips.watch: Soul – The Sky Lounge is now Soul Atrium, a 2,300 sq ft restaurant on Purna Das Road, so this pin may be the old address.
tips.tip: Search for Soul Atrium on Purna Das Road, Gariahat, instead.

lmnoq-skybar.blurb: An 8,000 sq ft, 150-seat skybar on the 12th floor of Magma House, Park Street, with panoramic city views.

tips.expect: A large rooftop with global food and cocktails from a noted mixologist.
tips.watch: It reopened after a closure, so check that it is open before you go.
tips.tip: A strong date-night option on Park Street.

botanik.blurb: An open-air lounge at the Golden Parkk hotel on Ho Chi Minh Sarani, with a green theme and Victoria Memorial in the sunset view.

tips.expect: A large 9,500 sq ft space in three zones: a lounge, an open-air deck and a covered glasshouse.
tips.good: The sunset, and the glasshouse for rainy nights.
tips.watch: A luxury hotel venue, so it is pricey.
tips.tip: Reach by sunset.

country-roads-micro-brewery-and-restaura.blurb: A microbrewery in The Galleria, New Town, with German Weizen, Belgian Blonde and Scottish Ale on tap.

tips.expect: A cosy, lively brewpub with Instagram-friendly interiors.
tips.watch: It is in New Town, away from the Puja circuits.
tips.tip: Only worth it if you are already in New Town.

club-de-golf.blurb: A golf arena at Eco Park, New Town (near Gate 6), on about 20 acres with a 12-stand driving range.

tips.expect: A golf driving range where you can rent clubs and balls and hire trainers.
tips.watch: This is an activity venue rather than a restaurant, and it is a long way from the pandals.
tips.tip: Skip it for Puja planning unless you are visiting Eco Park.

mnky-house-cafe-and-lounge.blurb: A chic cafe and lounge in DLF Galleria, New Town, with kaleidoscopic interiors, monkey artwork and neon.

tips.expect: A colourful, photogenic cafe-lounge.
tips.watch: It is in New Town and mall hours apply.
tips.tip: Only if you are already in New Town.

the-drunken-monkey-o2-hotel.blurb: A nightclub run by O2 VIP hotel on VIP Road, with a colourful decor and a dance floor for up to about 150 people.

tips.expect: A dance club rather than a restaurant.
tips.watch: Private bookings are taken on some weeknights.
tips.tip: Call ahead for entry rules.

canteen-pub-and-grub.blurb: A pub on the 3rd floor of City Centre 1, Salt Lake, with live music and a dance floor.

tips.expect: A casual pub with pasta, pizza, seafood and street food. About ₹1,200 for two.
tips.good: The live music and the easy menu.
tips.tip: A good Salt Lake wind-down.

chai-break-cafe-and-bar.blurb: A cafe and bar in City Centre, Salt Lake, with a long list of teas and coffees and a mix of Indian, Italian and Continental food.

tips.expect: A casual, social place.
tips.good: The tea and coffee variety, and the desserts.
tips.tip: A calm break during a City Centre dinner.

the-conclave-city-centre-salt-lake.blurb: A restaurant on the 7th floor of City Centre, Salt Lake, serving club food and 1950s Park Street dishes. It sits above the Afraa deli.

tips.expect: A sit-down meal. About ₹2,000 for two, before taxes, without alcohol.
tips.tip: Good for an unhurried dinner.

the-orient.blurb: A pan-Asian restaurant on the 4th floor of City Centre 1, Salt Lake, serving Chinese, Japanese and Thai food, with a rating of about 4.3.

tips.expect: A modern, spacious room with sushi, seafood and a bar.
tips.tip: A Salt Lake dinner after the Sector 1 blocks.

barf-soda-paani-park-street.blurb: A modern pub on the first floor of Magma House, Park Street, built around free, unlimited soda and water on the house.

tips.expect: A lively, affordable Park Street pub.
tips.good: Reasonable prices and the free soda-and-water concept.
tips.tip: Good for a big, budget-conscious group.

carpe-diem.blurb: A Park Street area restaurant at 18M Mother Teresa Sarani, known for refreshing mocktails and drinks.

tips.expect: A relaxed restaurant suitable for family meals and groups.
tips.tip: A practical stop on Park Street.
